Receiving <pve 50 /> <pvp [120] /> damage within 2 seconds of each hit grants 'Protective Wish' for 7 seconds.

Protective Wish grants 30 Reload Speed, 5% decreased Reload Animation Duration, 10% Flinch Resistance, and makes Combatants less accurate when targeting you.

5 second cooldown after the buff expires.

source.text:
2 Piece | A Wish for Protection

Upon receiving 50 [120] damage within 2 seconds of each damage instance:
Grants Protective Wish for 7 seconds.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown once the buff expires before it can be triggered again.

Protective Wish:
+30 Reload Speed, 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier, and 10% Flinch Resist.
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer.
